label: Review
title: Four questions before release.
intro: A user saves a private draft to finish later. What do you check before release?

code-review-and-quality.label: Code quality
code-review-and-quality.question: Is the last saved edit still there when you close the draft and reopen it?

accessibility-engineering.label: Accessibility
accessibility-engineering.question: Does a screen reader announce that the draft was saved without the user having to find the confirmation?

security-and-hardening.label: Security
security-and-hardening.question: When someone opens or saves a draft, does the server check that it belongs to the signed-in user?

performance-optimization.label: Performance
performance-optimization.question: On a slow connection, how long does it take for the user to see that the draft has been saved?
